headline: The secret quest to preserve Palestinian writer Raja Shehadeh's diaries
context: Leading Palestinian writer Raja Shehadeh has documented Israel's occupation of the West Bank since day one. Fearing the occupation might consume his archive, he secretly moved it to Scotland
